recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17655 unless future publication-surface checks uncover a generated artifact inconsistency outside the authoritative source.
issue_request: FHIR-17655 asked to remove the modifier flag from DocumentReference.relatesTo, noting that the relationship element does only what it says and that status should be the only modifier. The issue is Published, resolved Persuasive, and applied for R5.
initial_application: The Jira comment records pre-application in SVN 14690. Git-SVN commit e65b5381c0c2734c9852211d49e9dd65a7965a7c implements GF#17655 by removing the old spreadsheet Y marker from DocumentReference.relatesTo in source/documentreference/documentreference-spreadsheet.xml.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml marks DocumentReference.status as isModifier true and has no isModifier or isModifierReason metadata on DocumentReference.relatesTo. Zulip snapshots show the original chat rationale and later DocumentReference block-vote listing GF#17655 as Persuasive. The existing combined-branch FHIR-15585 audit is related context and already records the broader modifier-removal family.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already implements the requested non-modifier state for DocumentReference.relatesTo.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue covered missing isModifierReason for DocumentReference.relatesTo and resolved by removing modifier flags; it already has a combined-branch audit and is only context for this seed.
